gates.requirement: Each backbone has exactly 720 unique expected question-condition keys; row hashes match run manifests; physical prediction and manifest hashes match the canonical-v2 freeze.
A separately frozen Stage-A generator has no access to questions, gold SQL, predictions, scores, or correctness.
State hashes, mutation traces, pinned SQLite version/compile options, and clean deterministic rerun are present.
Formal states use foreign_keys=ON, pass integrity/FK checks, and execute all 180 gold SQL statements.
All 180 questions have predeclared relevance coverage, all five snapshot-empty queries become nonempty, and changed/unchanged gold counts are reported per state.
All 114 order-sensitive and 18 top-k questions have independently adjudicated total-order/tie policy.
Sequence/multiset/NULL behavior is retained, float comparison is pairwise and boundary-tested, and output-column policy is frozen.
No states or candidates are selected/removed after scores are viewed; all refreezes are versioned and retain unfavorable states.
Finite-corpus estimands, paired clustered contrasts, a predeclared multiplicity family, state coverage, and adjudication holds are reported.
An independent atomic-row rerun reproduces scores, statistics, tables, figures, and their manifest hashes.
